info.description: This dataset is composed of raw crowdsourced annotations of aerial imagery of wintering migratory waterfowl. Imagery was collected at Bosque del Apache National Wildlife Refuge and Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge 2017-2018. At most sites, a DJI Mavic Pro 2 equipped with a Hasselblad L1D-20c sensor was deployed; at Maxwell NWR, a Sensefly EBEE+ equipped with a S.O.D.A. sensor was deployed. Volunteers from the citizen science platform Zooniverse (https://www.zooniverse.org/projects/rowan-aspire/drones-for-ducks) provided annotations; identifying information has been removed but labeler ID has been preserved in this dataset. Contact the Center for the Advancement of Spatial Informatics Research and Education (ASPIRE, aspire@unm.edu) for more information.
